messages:
OpsLead: Quick heads-up 1: planned GPU backfill + AZ reshuffle on 2026-03-24 02:00-04:00 UTC. Affects us-west-2 primary GPU pool. Expect transient routing to us-west-2b and short eviction bursts for non-pinned Dedicated nodes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-backfill-2026-03-24
Infra-Oncall: Taking this window. Execution plan: 10-min canary drains, verify KV cache warmup, then proceed in waves. Will post step confirmations here.
Maria: Can someone add a Console banner and a brief status page note? Ill post to #customer-status and tag pinned tenants. :loudspeaker:
OpsLead: Draft status copy: "Planned maintenance: brief latency increase and temporary routing changes. No customer data impact." Keep it conservative.
Sahana: Ops checklist item: disable cluster-autoscaler during each drain step to prevent churn. Add to runbook prep.
Tom: KV warmup ops: scale warmup deployment and hit the warmup endpoint for top prefixes. Example commands added to runbook.
Infra-Oncall: Are there any Dedicated customers pinned to specific GPU IDs that need to be excluded? I can build an exclude list.
OpsLead: Two tenants pinned in us-west-2c. Exclude node label "dedicated:tenant-omega". Ill update the runbook excludes.
k8s-deploy-bot: Reminder: cordon/drain jobs will auto-start at 02:10 UTC if not manually acked.
sre-bot: Event created: gpu-backfill-2026-03-24. Pager duty assigned to Infra-Oncall.
Tom: After warmup run a short canary loadcheck (wrk or internal harness) to validate KV hit-rate and p50/p99.
Sahana: Apply SLO alert grace window 02:00-04:30 UTC so we avoid noisy pages. Postmortem if error-rate > 2x baseline.
OpsLead: Confirmed: SLO overrides in place 02:00-04:30 UTC. Post-action: collect perf histograms and model-variant correlations. Use postmortem template if needed.
Infra-Oncall: Ill run a preflight at 23:30 UTC and post results here. Will update live during the window with timestamps and decisions.
OpsLead: Thanks everyone 1: follow the runbook checklist and keep replies brief in this thread; DM if you need extra hands.
